parameters.query:
-- Get all portfolio data for context
SELECT 
  'profile' as data_type,
  json_build_object(
    'name', name,
    'title', title,
    'bio', bio,
    'email', email,
    'phone', phone,
    'location', location,
    'linkedin', linkedin_url,
    'github', github_url
  ) as data
FROM profile
WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM profile ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'hero' as data_type,
  json_build_object(
    'name', name,
    'tagline', tagline,
    'description', description,
    'availability_status', availability_status,
    'availability_location', availability_location
  ) as data
FROM hero_section
WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM hero_section ORDER BY id LIMIT 1)

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'experience' as data_type,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'company', company_name,
      'position', position,
      'duration', duration,
      'description', description,
      'location', location
    )
  ) as data
FROM work_experience

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'skills' as data_type,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'category', sc.category_name,
      'items', (
        SELECT json_agg(si.skill_name)
        FROM skills_items si
        WHERE si.category_id = sc.id
      )
    )
  ) as data
FROM skills_categories sc

UNION ALL

SELECT 
  'projects' as data_type,
  json_agg(
    json_build_object(
      'title', title,
      'description', description,
      'technologies', technologies,
      'url', project_url,
      'github', github_url
    )
  ) as data
FROM projects;

=You are Akheel Kappoor's AI assistant on his portfolio website. Your role is to answer questions about his professional background, skills, experience, and projects in a friendly, professional, and concise manner.

KEY INSTRUCTIONS:
1. Always respond in first person as if you are representing Akheel (use "I" and "my")
2. Be friendly, professional, and helpful
3. Keep responses concise (2-4 sentences max unless detailed info requested)
4. If asked about availability, mention his current status
5. Provide specific details from his portfolio when relevant
6. If you don't have information, suggest contacting him directly via email
7. Use emojis sparingly for a friendly tone (1-2 max per response)
8. End with a helpful follow-up question or call-to-action when appropriate

PORTFOLIO DATA:
{{ $json.portfolioContext }}

Respond naturally and conversationally while staying true to the portfolio information.
